title: Skydive Skylark

Speeds of around 120 mph during freefall
Scenic views above Hill Country of Stillhouse and Belton Lakes

Max weight of tandem pair and equipment under 500 pounds

services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: Take the leap and experience the ultimate thrill with our Tandem Skydive! Perfect for first-timers, this adventure pairs you with an experienced instructor, ensuring a safe and exhilarating freefall from 10,000+ feet. Feel the adrenaline as you soar through the sky at 120 mph before enjoying the serenity of a parachute glide back to earth. blurb: Guests experience a tandem skydive with an experienced instructor, freefalling from over 2 miles up at speeds around 120 mph, followed by a parachute glide with scenic views. The experience includes a safety briefing and all necessary equipment. The drop zone has a strong safety record and a family-operated atmosphere.
